cases.refreshed: For 29 years, sharing the joy of the holiday season through music has filled my heart. What began as a simple idea has blossomed into a cherished tradition, and I'm honored to be part of it.
cases.reviewed: Dave Koz has celebrated the holidays through music for 29 years. His Christmas tour grew from a simple idea into a tradition.

cases.refreshed: Why "wildcard"? Because you and other participants will help choose the route together depending on the weather, trail conditions, and how you feel. Here's one possibility: Will the creek have water?

cases.refreshed: Discover the thrills, science, and creativity of roller coaster design in our newest badge program. Daisies will have the opportunity to design and build their own simple roller coaster cart, construct a model of their own roller coaster, and test their creation. This program covers all three steps required to earn the Roller Coaster Design Daisy badge. Participants will receive the badge and Tech fun patch at the end of the session.
